hypothesis: V40 P1 improved the fixed 183-truth development geometry result to 140 true positives, 47 false positives and 43 false negatives, but failed the unchanged 95 percent precision and recall bars. Its inverse target is decoder-compatible, while the frozen head was optimized with a region-level Dice loss over targets occupying about one percent of pixels. Replacing only the positive-panel objective with a fixed 3:1 hard-negative-mined binary cross-entropy may improve learned probability boundaries and extent without changing the parent, features, targets, postprocessor or operating point. isolated_change: Replace only V40's positive-panel Dice objective with binary cross-entropy over every valid positive pixel plus the three highest-loss valid negative pixels per positive. Preserve V40's empty-target masked mean-probability behavior. Keep the exact reviewed pretrained parent, frozen trunk and running statistics, cached original-BGR input features, inverse-unclip targets, all-one supervision masks, train-only seed, epoch count, batch size, optimizer, learning rate, weight decay, draw order, full-train minimum-loss checkpoint selection, ONNX patching, production preprocessing and postprocessing, and operating point unchanged. The 3:1 ratio is fixed before execution. This is the BCELoss option supported by PaddleOCR BalanceLoss, not an exact reproduction of the pinned PP-OCRv5 multi-branch DBLoss, whose shrink branch selects DiceLoss.
